datasets.name: VFHQ

Datasets and Preprocessing. We train our model on the
VFHQ dataset [62], which contains 15,204 video clips (3M
frames) from diverse interview scenarios. Following estab-
lished practices [7, 48], we process each frame by detecting
face regions, expanding bounding boxes to capture head and
hair context, and resizing to 512 × 512 pixels. To ensure
geometric consistency, we track camera poses and FLAME
parameters across sequences using the pipeline from [48].
Additionally, we perform background removal following [8]
and head parsing with [11] to isolate subjects and minimize
background interference during training. For evaluation, we
use the official VFHQ test split, where the first frame serves
as the source image and subsequent frames provide driving
signals and target views for reenactment evaluation.
